name: Paradise -KIWAME-
source:
Paradise -KIWAME-, the second Paradise fan disk, is positioned as the "truth".

The stage is a solitary island like the main story, but a completely different development awaits.  "Another story" depicting another possibility on that island.

In Paradise -KIWAME-, like the main story [Paradise], everyone lands in Kashima and the tour begins. Their actions are different from the main story. As a result, new things will unfold. And everyone escaped from the island with their lives and headed to a new world.

A new drama that captures true happiness between Azuma and his friends.

[Translated & edited from the  [url=http://pilslash.jp/product/paradise_fd2/]official site.[/url] ]
translation:
《Paradise》的第二部粉丝向衍生作品《Paradise -KIWAME-》，以“真相”为定位。

舞台与本篇一样，是一座孤岛，但等待众人的却是截然不同的发展。这是描绘那座岛上另一种可能性的“另一个故事”。

《Paradise -KIWAME-》与本篇《Paradise》一样，以众人登上砥鹿岛、开始旅行揭开序幕。然而，他们采取了与本篇不同的行动，由此带来了新的发展。最终，所有人都活着逃离了岛屿，走向新的世界。

这是一部描绘Azuma与伙伴们获得真正幸福的新故事。

[根据[url=http://pilslash.jp/product/paradise_fd2/]官方网站[/url]翻译并整理]
